status: cumulative partial snapshot; only labels accepted by incremental audit at snapshot time are included
acceptance_meaning: SCF converged, finite energy and forces, matching frozen geometry hashes and atom count; this is an operational label audit, not a claim that the DFT numerical settings are fully converged.

dft_protocol.fit_energy_target: force-consistent finite-smearing free energy at sigma=0.10 eV
dft_protocol.stress: recorded where available; not a fit target
dft_protocol.qualification: Exploratory labeling setting. It does not mean the earlier plane-wave/k-point/smearing convergence review was formally passed.
